name: Ibashocon
blurb: An anime convention, now in its third year, at the Hilton Raleigh North Hills in Raleigh, North Carolina.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'HILTON RALEIGH NORTH HILLS FEB. 26TH, 2027, @4PM THRU FEB. 28TH, 2027, @5PM' and 'LOCATION HILTON RALEIGH NORTH HILLS 3415 Wake Forest Rd, Raleigh, NC 27609'

notes: Meta description notes 2027 is the con's '3rd year'. No organizer/company name is stated anywhere on the rendered homepage, so organizer is left blank. The /guests page rendered with no guest candidates (only the site logo), so guests is 'none-yet' for 2027; the homepage instead shows photos from the 2026 event ('CHECK OUT IMAGES FROM 2026 BELOW!'), which were not used as guest or cover material since they are crowd/attendee photos, not guest or key art.
